name: A Valentine's Tryst
source:
Gilbert and Hugh were best friends since an extremely young age, but they gradually fell out of touch during their high school years.

10 years later, these old friends have a chance encounter on Valentine's Day. What will come of this?

Will they reform their friendship? Or possibly become something even more...?

[From [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/a-valentines-tryst]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
吉尔伯特和休从很小的时候起就是最好的朋友，但他们在高中时期逐渐失去联系。

10年后，这些老朋友在情人节偶遇。这会发生什么？

他们会修复他们的友谊吗？或者可能变得更加……？

[来自[url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/a-valentines-tryst]Itch.io[/url]]
